decision: Replace accordion drop-down delivery view with a WebGL node graph rendered via deck.gl (OrthographicView + ScatterplotLayer + PathLayer + TextLayer), surfacing Epic→Sprint→Story→Sub-task→PR hierarchy with type-fill colours and status-ring colours per node.
key_insight: Two visual encodings on a single circle (inner fill = node type, outer ring = status) make Jira/GitHub provenance and workflow state legible at a glance without ambiguity.
alternatives_considered: Accordion drop-down tree (DeliveryTree.tsx) — user-rejected: reinvents Jira, no spatial sense of project state
Flat table / timeline axis view — rejected: wrong mental model
rejected_reason: Accordion approach was rejected by user — no spatial overview, Jira vs GitHub items indistinguishable
